name: TV Cabinet
note: TV Cabinet on Tapered Legs with Slatted Door in Oak or Beech.
description: A low cabinet with hand-slatted doors, built to sit under a television and hide everything that plugs into it. The slats are ripped from one plank so the grain runs continuously across both doors, and the legs are tapered by hand so the whole thing reads lighter than it is.

name: Pendant Light Beam
note: A beautiful, solid pendant light for over your table, with adjustable brightness and colour.
description: A beautiful, solid pine beam suspended over your dining table on two steel cables, fitted with warm LEDs recessed into the underside so you see light, not fittings. Both the brightness and the colour temperature are adjustable, so it can be candle-warm for dinner or bright and neutral for working. It replaces the usual single lamp with one long, even wash of light.
materials: Solid pine, planed and softened edges
Clear hardwax oil or black stain
